actions.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 connects to a login prompt, and leave it running until ready.
required_artifacts: A reachable localhost TCP service on port 6665 that presents a login prompt when connected via telnet
required_behaviors: Block until the telnet service on 127.0.0.1:6665 is ready and shows a login prompt
Preserve the running VM after readiness is confirmed
known_invalid_patterns: Treating file existence or command success as sufficient without confirming the telnet login prompt
Stopping QEMU after readiness instead of leaving it running
Using a different port or service that does not satisfy telnet 127.0.0.1 6665
verification_plan: Inspect the environment for the ISO path and available QEMU tooling
Start QEMU with a serial/console configuration that exposes a telnet server on port 6665
Probe localhost:6665 until the login prompt is observed
Record receipts for the launch and readiness confirmation
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the QEMU launch command running in the background
Receipt-backed evidence that telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 reaches a login prompt
notes: The original request is the authoritative success criterion; do not substitute weaker checks.

plan: Locate /app/alpine.iso and determine a QEMU invocation that exposes a telnet-accessible console on 127.0.0.1:6665
Launch QEMU in the background and keep it running
Probe 127.0.0.1:6665 until the login prompt is confirmed
Capture receipts for both launch and readiness
